browser_command_definition: One selected nonempty browser-code batch per decision; a batch may contain multiple browser/CDP calls. Unselected candidate batches and selection calls do not count.
comparison_caveat: Task validity subsets and live collection windows differ; historical-versus-fresh comparisons are descriptive.

extension_metadata.prompt_limit_caveat: Historical 60-decision single enforced 60 but advertised 30; new single120 enforces and advertises 120. Live windows and validity subsets differ.

paired_statistics.collection_window_caveat: Pairing controls task identity, not collection time.

points.metric_caveat: Own valid-task means; frozen native usage pricing upper bound excludes Terra and is not an invoice. Actor latency excludes Terra. Missing task outcomes are never imputed.
